name: sven-coop-udp
description: Sven Co-op / GoldSrc dedicated server direct UDP profile
author: plugin-studio

known_ports.notes: GoldSrc/Sven Co-op default game server UDP port

launch_args: Point Sven Co-op clients at the ROAD client listen address, usually 127.0.0.1:27015.
notes: ROAD carries direct UDP traffic only; Steam server browser and Steam auth traffic are outside this tunnel.
Keep udp_peer_broadcast disabled; GoldSrc gameplay traffic is server-authoritative UDP.
For private validation prefer sv_lan 1 / direct console connect.
Sven Co-op dedicated server AppID is 276060.
Recommended ROAD client listen address is 127.0.0.1:27015 for direct in-game connect.
